newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tiger Medicals in India joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Tiger Medicals in India joint venture.

text.p: Singapore pharmaceutical firm Tiger Medicals Ltd said on Monday it had set up a joint venture firm Haw Par Medicals (India) Pte Ltd with Indian partners.
Haw Par Medicals will make and distribute Tiger Balm products in the growing Indian market under license from Tiger Medicals, the company said in a statement.
It said Elder Health Care Ltd would be appointed as contract manufacturer and Elder Pharmaceuticals Ltd the sub-distributor.
It said Tiger Medicals would take 60 percent of the initial 2.0 million rupee issued share capital of Haw Par Medicals.
Indian partners, four individuals, would take the other 40 percent.
